title: Learning to Choose: Training an Agent from Trajectories
outcome: Train a seeded softmax policy with REINFORCE and evaluate a separate success predicate.
prerequisites: The mapped chapter and its notation

input_fields.rewards: Finite verifier reward per one-step action.
input_fields.success_probabilities: External success chance per action in [0,1].
input_fields.terminal_potentials: Potential value of each terminal action outcome; zero is the episodic invariant condition.

equations.label: EQV13-01
explanations: Equation (13.1) separates observations, sampled actions, rewards, terminal condition, and return-to-go.
Observe, choose action, receive reward and next observation; stop at terminal `o_T`.

equations.label: EQV13-02
explanations: Equation (13.2) estimates how changing action probabilities changes expected trajectory return.
Raise probability of sampled actions in proportion to discounted return-to-go, averaged over trajectories.

equations.label: EQV13-03
explanations: Equation (13.3) moves some feedback between stages through a stated state potential.
Add the discounted potential of the next state and subtract the potential of the state just left.

equations.label: EQV13-04
explanations: Equation (13.4) shows exactly which terms remain after intermediate potential changes cancel.
Interior potentials telescope away; the initial and discounted terminal potentials survive.
